name: Chen-Gackstatter Surface

definition.note: No closed form is stored for this surface. It is defined by its shipped implementation in math_art.minsurf.parametric, which is authoritative; an unverified transcription would silently define a different surface.

total_curvature.note: M. Weber (minsurf ch058): 'The Chen-Gackstatter surface of genus g has finite total curvature -4pi(g+1), the largest possible value for its genus'; g = 1 here.

provenance.definition: Derived from the Math Art generator registries and cross-referenced to the literature; not transcribed from any gallery's compilation.
sources: C. C. Chen and F. Gackstatter, 'Elliptische und hyperelliptische Funktionen und vollstandige Minimalflachen vom Enneperschen Typ', Math. Ann. 259 (1982).
C. C. Chen, F. Gackstatter, Math. Ann. 259 (1982) 359-369; M. Weber (mirror: minsurf ch058): total curvature -4pi(g+1) for the genus-g member, 'the largest possible value for its genus'.

discovered_by: Chi Cheng Chen and Fritz Gackstatter
